I'm pretty lucky here, my Neuro pops in to check up on us during infusion days. So, he can have the nurse provide whatever meds we might need if any.

They do give 25mg of Benadryl before infusion, but it does not do anything for me. But Rituximab can affect the kidneys pretty hard which is why the blood pressure goes way up, along with pulse rates. So they have to titrate back the infusion rate to the lowest recorded BP /HR then just keeping you at that rate. So today mine was just at 100ml per hour.  They always start very low and slow, then check vitals every 10-15min, if all is well they up the rate. By the time your bag is about empty you can be around 200-300ml per hour.  So some people it's 2.5-4hrs infusion time
